title: UE radio capability ID deletion indication

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: An information element that may be included in WB-S1 mode to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition that the UE and network are operating in WB-S1 mode.

entities.name: RACS support
entities.description: Condition that both the UE and the network support RACS (Radio Access Capability Signaling).

entities.name: Delete UE radio capability IDs
entities.description: Property indicating the UE should delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored for the serving PLMN.

relations.description: The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the UE is in WB-S1 mode.
The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support RACS.
The IE establishes the property that the UE should delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs for the serving PLMN.
